---
title: "Harmonization of Global and National Forest Cover Products"
format: gfm
---

**A goal of large-area land cover mapping is to produce globally consistent characterizations that have local relevance and utility; that is, reliable information across scales.** (Hansen et al. 2013)

This package obtains yearly forest cover maps from the Global Forest Cover dataset (Hansen et al. 2013) and compares them pixelwise with Colombian Forest Cover datasets produced by the Forests and Carbon Monitoring System (SMBYC) at IDEAM.

## Installation

```{r}
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("RSENSUS/harmonizacion_hansenIdeam")
```

## Objectives

- Assess agreement between GLAD GFC and IDEAM forest products across canopy cover thresholds.
- Identify thresholds that maximize overall agreement per biome.
- Fill spatial/temporal gaps while matching national definitions and leveraging local validation data.

## Study Area

Continental Colombia, split into ~379 ecological subunits (biomes; Londoño et al., 2017).

## Data Sources (IDEAM vs GLAD)

| Criteria | IDEAM | GLAD |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Spatial Resolution | 30m | 30m |
| Coverage | National | Global |
| Frequency | Irregular | Annual |
| Years | 1990, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2012–2019 | 2000–2020 |
| Strengths | Distinguishes planted vs. natural forests; official reference | Annual updates; multiple canopy thresholds |
| Weaknesses | Irregular cadence; data loss from SLC-off/clouds | No planted vs. natural distinction; no forest gain for most years |

## Methods (Summary)

1. Exclude canopy-forming crops (oil palm, agroforestry) based on national land cover maps.
2. Build change maps (forest persistence, non-forest persistence, forest loss) for IDEAM 2010–2017.
3. Generate analogous maps from GFC across canopy thresholds (20–100%, finer steps at high cover).
4. Compute agreement per biome; select threshold maximizing overall agreement.
5. Use biome-specific optimal thresholds to derive harmonized annual maps (2012–2021).

### Outputs

- Per-biome optimal canopy thresholds and agreement metrics.
- Harmonized annual forest/non-forest maps for Colombia.
- Area-weighted agreement summaries between IDEAM and harmonized GFC.
